script_text: Capricorn, an Earth sign ruled by Saturn, this month forces a strategic upgrade. Jupiter is in Cancer, moving through your 4th House—the dominant transit. It opposes your Capricorn Sun, expanding authority and vision. Venus in Gemini occupies your 3rd House, and its retrograde motion favors explicit conversation. A flirtation may deepen; partners should address the misunderstanding. Saturn in Gemini squares the Sun in Libra in your 7th House, so home or property duties may affect work. Use Jupiter’s expansion for a promotion or contract, but verify financial details. Mars in Scorpio activates your 8th House, boosting emotional stamina but warning against stress and sleep disruption. Watch September 10 for Mars trine Jupiter in Cancer, September 27 for the Sun’s opposition to Pluto in Aries, and October 5 for Saturn square the Sun in Libra. Avoid impulsive promises and stress at work. Share forecast with a Capricorn who needs it.
